title: Syntagma sacrae theologiae (Liber II Cap. 7 densify complete)
author: Ludwig Crocius
edition: Syntagma sacrae theologiae (Bremen: Berthold Villerian, 1636). VD17 14:684303C. SLUB id335860389. Liber II Cap. 7 De resurrectione carnis COMPLETE (mid PHYS 381-mid-384 before CAPUT OCTAVUM).
blurb: Ludwig Crocius — Book II Chapter 7 On the resurrection of the flesh, from the 1636 Bremen Latin. Densify COMPLETE (mid PHYS 381–mid-384): Cap. 7 title; Scripture beyond reason; new inseparable union; Gentile vestiges; Democritus from tradition not reason — Cap. 7 close. Cap. 8 starts mid PHYS 384. Liber I Cap.1–11 and Liber II Cap.1–5 COMPLETE (english not modified).
